transitionOrder: Inventory every live IAM OIDC trust and record its current subject.
Add an exact custom-subject statement alongside each still-required legacy subject; do not remove legacy access first.
PUT the repository subject template with repo, context, and job_workflow_ref and use_default false.
Inspect a safe OIDC token or perform a non-mutating AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity test for each migrated workflow.
Set the protected production environment variable PRODUCTION_STAGE_B_IMAGE_PUBLISH_ROLE only after publisher assumption succeeds.
Remove legacy-subject statements only after all listed consumers have passed their non-mutating verification.
rollback: Restore each verified legacy IAM subject before changing GitHub configuration.
PUT the repository subject template with use_default true.
Run a non-mutating OIDC assumption test for every restored consumer before resuming dispatches.
